pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_occasions AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS occasion_count FROM "donations" GROUP BY "Donor"), multi_donors AS (SELECT "Donor" FROM donor_occasions WHERE occasion_count > 1), total_amount AS (SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amt FROM "donations"), multi_donor_amount AS (SELECT SUM(d."Amount") AS multi_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT d."Donor") AS donor_count FROM "donations" AS d INNER JOIN multi_donors AS m ON d."Donor" = m."Donor") SELECT (m.multi_amt * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(t.total_amt, 0), 0)) AS percent_from_multi_donors, m.donor_count AS number_of_multi_donors FROM multi_donor_amount AS m CROSS JOIN total_amount AS t

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
WITH donor_occasions AS (
    SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS occasion_count
    FROM "donations"
    GROUP BY "Donor"
),
multi_donors AS (
    SELECT "Donor"
    FROM donor_occasions
    WHERE occasion_count > 1
),
total_amount AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amt
    FROM "donations"
),
multi_donor_amount AS (
    SELECT SUM(d."Amount") AS multi_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT d."Donor") AS donor_count
    FROM "donations" d
    INNER JOIN multi_donors m ON d."Donor" = m."Donor"
)
SELECT 
    (m.multi_amt * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_amt, 0)) AS percent_from_multi_donors,
    m.donor_count AS number_of_multi_donors
FROM multi_donor_amount m
CROSS JOIN total_amount t;
